meanings.en: a substance that is present in small amounts in another substance, making it dirty or of a lower quality
meanings.exampleEn: The filter removes any impurity from the drinking water.
meanings.exampleTr: Filtre içme suyundaki her türlü safsızlığı temizler.

meanings.en: in a way that shows doubt or uncertainty
meanings.exampleEn: She looked at the offer dubiously before saying no.
meanings.exampleTr: Teklife hayır demeden önce kuşkuyla baktı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you want to know something
meanings.exampleEn: He raised his eyebrows inquiringly, waiting for an answer.
meanings.exampleTr: Bir cevap bekleyerek kaşlarını soran bir şekilde kaldırdı.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you are puzzled or mildly amused
meanings.exampleEn: She tilted her head and looked at me quizzically.
meanings.exampleTr: Başını yana eğdi ve bana sorgularcasına baktı.

meanings.tr: kılı kırk yararak itiraz etme, önemsiz şeyleri eleştirme
meanings.en: making unnecessary complaints about small, unimportant details
meanings.exampleEn: Stop cavilling about the minor faults and look at the whole plan.
meanings.exampleTr: Küçük kusurları eleştirmeyi bırak da planın bütününe bak.

meanings.en: the quality of being fast or quick
meanings.exampleEn: The swiftness of the rescue saved many lives.
meanings.exampleTr: Kurtarmanın çabukluğu birçok hayatı kurtardı.

meanings.en: the quality of being based on chance or personal whim rather than reason
meanings.exampleEn: People complained about the arbitrariness of the new rules.
meanings.exampleTr: İnsanlar yeni kuralların keyfiliğinden şikayet etti.

meanings.en: the quality of doing something too quickly and without enough thought
meanings.exampleEn: He later regretted the hastiness of his decision.
meanings.exampleTr: Sonradan kararının aceleciliğinden pişman oldu.

meanings.en: the quality of not being based on clear thought or reason
meanings.exampleEn: The irrationality of his fear was obvious to everyone.
meanings.exampleTr: Korkusunun mantıksızlığı herkes için apaçıktı.

meanings.en: a feeling of satisfaction from doing or achieving something
meanings.exampleEn: She finds great fulfilment in her work as a teacher.
meanings.exampleTr: Öğretmen olarak işinde büyük bir tatmin buluyor.

meanings.en: the act of achieving or completing something that was hoped for or promised
meanings.exampleEn: The trip was the fulfilment of a lifelong dream.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu gezi ömür boyu süren bir hayalin gerçekleşmesiydi.

meanings.en: past tense and past participle of 'understand'; grasped the meaning of something
meanings.exampleEn: I understood the instructions after reading them twice.
meanings.exampleTr: Talimatları iki kez okuduktan sonra anladım.

meanings.en: agreed on or accepted by everyone without being said directly
meanings.exampleEn: It was understood that everyone would share the cost.
meanings.exampleTr: Herkesin masrafı paylaşacağı zımnen anlaşılmıştı.

meanings.tr: tanıdı, fark etti (recognise fiilinin geçmiş hali)
meanings.en: past tense of 'recognise'; identified someone or something known before
meanings.exampleEn: I recognised her voice as soon as she spoke.
meanings.exampleTr: Konuşur konuşmaz sesini tanıdım.

meanings.en: officially accepted or approved as valid or important
meanings.exampleEn: It is a recognised qualification in many countries.
meanings.exampleTr: Birçok ülkede tanınan bir yeterliliktir.

meanings.tr: yeniden ortaya çıkma, tekrar yüzeye çıkma
meanings.en: appearing again after being hidden or forgotten for a time
meanings.exampleEn: Old rumours are resurfacing after the scandal.
meanings.exampleTr: Skandalın ardından eski söylentiler yeniden ortaya çıkıyor.

meanings.en: putting a new surface on a road or other area
meanings.exampleEn: The council is resurfacing the main road next week.
meanings.exampleTr: Belediye önümüzdeki hafta ana yolun kaplamasını yeniliyor.

meanings.en: to think about something again in order to decide if you should change your opinion or plan
meanings.exampleEn: We need to reevaluate our strategy after these poor results.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu kötü sonuçların ardından stratejimizi yeniden değerlendirmemiz gerekiyor.

meanings.en: to set something again or return a device to its original state
meanings.exampleEn: You can reset your password by clicking this link.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu bağlantıya tıklayarak şifrenizi sıfırlayabilirsiniz.

meanings.en: an act of setting something again to its starting state
meanings.exampleEn: The relationship needed a complete reset after the argument.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu ilişkinin tartışmadan sonra tam bir sıfırlamaya ihtiyacı vardı.

meanings.tr: reddetmek, inkar etmek, sorumluluğunu kabul etmemek
meanings.en: to say that you know nothing about something or that you are not responsible for it
meanings.exampleEn: The party moved quickly to disavow the extremist comments.
meanings.exampleTr: Parti aşırılıkçı yorumları reddetmek için hızla harekete geçti.

meanings.en: to state firmly and publicly that something is true
meanings.exampleEn: The minister affirmed the government's commitment to the plan.
meanings.exampleTr: Bakan hükümetin plana bağlılığını doğruladı.

meanings.en: to give the main points of something in a short and clear way
meanings.exampleEn: Could you summarise the report in a few sentences?
meanings.exampleTr: Raporu birkaç cümleyle özetleyebilir misin?

meanings.en: to say something again or in a different way, often more clearly
meanings.exampleEn: Let me restate my main point so it is clear.
meanings.exampleTr: Ana fikrimi net olması için yeniden ifade edeyim.

meanings.en: willing to accept or be influenced by something; easy to persuade
meanings.exampleEn: She was amenable to changing the meeting time.
meanings.exampleTr: Toplantı saatini değiştirmeye yatkındı.

meanings.en: not willing to listen to or accept new ideas or suggestions
meanings.exampleEn: The board was unreceptive to the risky proposal.
meanings.exampleTr: Yönetim kurulu riskli teklife kapalıydı.

meanings.tr: yakıt ikmali yapmak, yeniden yakıt almak
meanings.en: to fill a vehicle or aircraft with more fuel
meanings.exampleEn: The plane stopped in Dubai to refuel.
meanings.exampleTr: Uçak yakıt ikmali yapmak için Dubai'de durdu.

meanings.en: involving two people or groups who both take part or communicate equally
meanings.exampleEn: Good communication is a two-way process.
meanings.exampleTr: İyi iletişim çift yönlü bir süreçtir.

meanings.en: done or decided by only one group or country without the agreement of others
meanings.exampleEn: The country made a unilateral decision to withdraw from the treaty.
meanings.exampleTr: Ülke anlaşmadan çekilmek için tek taraflı bir karar aldı.

meanings.en: happening again and again, often over a long period
meanings.exampleEn: He suffers from recurrent back pain.
meanings.exampleTr: Tekrarlayan sırt ağrısından muzdarip.

meanings.en: happening or made only once, not as part of a regular series
meanings.exampleEn: This is a one-off payment, not a monthly charge.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu aylık bir ücret değil, tek seferlik bir ödeme.

meanings.en: about or concerning; used especially at the start of a business letter or email to give the subject
meanings.exampleEn: Re: your invoice dated 5 March.
meanings.exampleTr: Konu: 5 Mart tarihli faturanız.

meanings.en: returning to a worse or less advanced condition than before
meanings.exampleEn: Critics called the new law a retrogressive step for women's rights.
meanings.exampleTr: Eleştirmenler yeni yasayı kadın hakları için geriletici bir adım olarak nitelendirdi.

meanings.en: the fact of happening again, or of returning after a period of absence
meanings.exampleEn: Doctors are watching for any recurrence of the disease.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar hastalığın herhangi bir nüksetmesine karşı tetikte.

meanings.en: the process of becoming worse in quality or condition
meanings.exampleEn: The doctors noticed a rapid deterioration in his health.
meanings.exampleTr: Doktorlar sağlığında hızlı bir kötüleşme fark etti.

meanings.en: in a way that continues without stopping or becoming less intense
meanings.exampleEn: She worked unremittingly to finish the project on time.
meanings.exampleTr: Projeyi zamanında bitirmek için aralıksız çalıştı.

meanings.en: with great effort over a long time, without becoming tired or giving up
meanings.exampleEn: Volunteers worked tirelessly to help the flood victims.
meanings.exampleTr: Gönüllüler sel mağdurlarına yardım etmek için yorulmadan çalıştı.

meanings.en: in a way that can be trusted or relied on to happen or work
meanings.exampleEn: The old car still starts dependably every morning.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski araba her sabah hala güvenilir bir şekilde çalışıyor.

meanings.en: in a way that cannot be trusted or relied on to work correctly
meanings.exampleEn: The internet connection works unreliably in this area.
meanings.exampleTr: İnternet bağlantısı bu bölgede güvenilmez bir şekilde çalışıyor.

meanings.en: the formal act of giving up a right, belief, or possession
meanings.exampleEn: His renunciation of the throne shocked the nation.
meanings.exampleTr: Tahttan feragat etmesi ulusu şok etti.

meanings.en: to enjoy food, drink, or an experience slowly and fully
meanings.exampleEn: She sat back to savor the last piece of chocolate.
meanings.exampleTr: Son çikolata parçasının tadını çıkarmak için arkasına yaslandı.

meanings.en: to make something exist or happen again, or to produce a copy of it
meanings.exampleEn: The film tries to recreate life in ancient Rome.
meanings.exampleTr: Film, antik Roma'daki yaşamı yeniden yaratmaya çalışıyor.

meanings.en: able to be repaired or put right
meanings.exampleEn: Don't worry, this problem is easily fixable.
meanings.exampleTr: Merak etme, bu sorun kolayca düzeltilebilir.

meanings.en: able to be corrected or put right
meanings.exampleEn: Most of these errors are correctable with a little practice.
meanings.exampleTr: Bu hataların çoğu biraz pratikle düzeltilebilir.

meanings.en: impossible to correct, cure, or put right
meanings.exampleEn: The damage to his reputation was irremediable.
meanings.exampleTr: İtibarına verilen zarar telafisi imkansızdı.

meanings.en: strongly reminding you of something
meanings.exampleEn: The old street was redolent of a bygone age.
meanings.exampleTr: Eski sokak geçmiş bir çağı çağrıştırıyordu.

meanings.en: having a strong smell of something
meanings.exampleEn: The kitchen was redolent of fresh coffee.
meanings.exampleTr: Mutfak taze kahve kokusuyla doluydu.

meanings.en: feeling or showing that you are sorry for something wrong you have done
meanings.exampleEn: He seemed genuinely repentant for the trouble he had caused.
meanings.exampleTr: Sebep olduğu sıkıntı için gerçekten pişman görünüyordu.

meanings.en: feeling very sorry and guilty for having done something wrong
meanings.exampleEn: She gave a contrite apology for her rude behaviour.
meanings.exampleTr: Kaba davranışı için pişman bir özür diledi.

meanings.en: cruel and showing no pity or regret
meanings.exampleEn: The soldiers were remorseless in their attack.
meanings.exampleTr: Askerler saldırılarında acımasızdı.

meanings.en: continuing in a way that cannot be stopped
meanings.exampleEn: The remorseless advance of technology changes daily life.
meanings.exampleTr: Teknolojinin amansız ilerleyişi günlük yaşamı değiştiriyor.

meanings.en: in a way that shows you feel very sorry for doing something wrong
meanings.exampleEn: He apologised contritely and promised never to do it again.
meanings.exampleTr: Pişmanlıkla özür diledi ve bir daha asla yapmayacağına söz verdi.
